transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we're here to discuss the prior-learning credit petition for the student with work experience in biological laboratory operations. Before I make my binding decision, I'd like to make sure we've followed our standard process. Has the faculty assessor submitted their report, and has the registrar completed the records review? I want to ensure we have both pieces in front of us before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the faculty assessment this week. The portfolio and observed practical demonstrate the competencies for exactly 6 credits, but I want to be clear that this credit recommendation is valid only if the observed practical is included alongside the portfolio.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've completed the records review, and I need to share an important finding from the state articulation record. These competencies must be posted as course equivalency BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, rather than as general biology elective credit or a letter grade.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Credits awarded contingent on the observed practical being included alongside the portfolio as part of the assessment record.
Credits to be posted as course equivalency BIO-115 with CR notation, not as general biology elective credit or a letter grade.
